$comment: Every {{TOKEN}} that may appear anywhere in drafts/**, ANNOTATIONS.md, FAQ-OSPO.md or decisions/** must be declared here. scripts/check-drafts.mjs fails the build on an undeclared token AND on a declared token nobody uses, so this file is the complete, auditable list of every token the draft texts use. Until 2026-09-08 that was the same thing as the list of everything not yet decided; a token whose constant has since been settled stays declared for as long as a text still writes it, and says so in its own `status`. Once the text writes the literal instead, the token is removed here — as STEWARD_ORG_LEGAL_NAME and STEWARD_ORG_SHORT_NAME were on 2026-09-16 (D48 item 13: the texts now write "Purpose Source Association" and "the Association"). Decision D10 (one canonical text, zero per-project parameters) means the SHIPPED text must resolve every token below to a literal constant — the tokens exist because the constants are not chosen yet, never because the text is meant to be filled in per project.

STEWARD_ORG_UID.blockedBy: the commercial-register entry (LEG-060): the Swiss enterprise identifier (UID) is assigned when the Purpose Source Association is entered in the commercial register. The founding assembly was held on 2026-09-16; the entry is pending. No value may be invented (D48 item 13).
STEWARD_ORG_UID.meaning: Swiss enterprise identifier (UID) of the Steward Organization, carried on the Purpose Notice line `UID: {{STEWARD_ORG_UID}}` as the identity anchor that keeps "the organization named in §1" verifiable after a name change, a merger or the loss of the domain (D48 item 13; the §8 counsel marker asked for it).
STEWARD_ORG_UID.note: The legal name itself is no longer a token: the texts write the literal "Purpose Source Association" (statutes Art. 1; D40 item 1; D48 item 13) and call it "the Association".

STEWARD_REGISTRY_URL.blockedBy: OPEN-02 (naming) — the apex domain purposesource.org is owned; the path is a build decision
STEWARD_REGISTRY_URL.meaning: Canonical steward registry URL that appears on the Purpose Notice line (GH-009).

LICENSE_ID.blockedBy: OPEN-20 (final canonical identifier string): the LicenseRef form was decided on 2026-09-16 (D48 item 9) and is valid SPDX for a licence not on the SPDX list; inclusion on the list is requested later, when adoption exists (LEG-029), and scanners may flag the identifier until then. Superseded: "PurposeSource-1.0" (working form)
LICENSE_ID.meaning: SPDX LicenseRef identifier on the Purpose Notice line, written as `SPDX-License-Identifier: {{LICENSE_ID}}` (GH-009). Must grep uniquely (VS-06).

LICENSE_TEXT_URL.blockedBy: OPEN-20 + the website build (VS-12: the byte-exact .txt endpoint must hash-match the canonical file in this repository)

GITHUB_ORG.blockedBy: none — the organization exists (confirmed 2026-09-08). Superseded: "D4 / OPEN-02 — the org name is proposed, not confirmed"
GITHUB_ORG.meaning: GitHub organization that hosts this repository and the registry repositories.
GITHUB_ORG.note: A settled token stays declared here because README.md still writes it as {{GITHUB_ORG}} and the inventory must account for every token the texts use — removing it would fail the gate, not tidy it. The steward organization's legal name was a separate token until 2026-09-16, when the texts began writing the literal "Purpose Source Association" (D48 item 13); only its UID is still a token.
